shortDescription.default: Governance outcomes from Teams meetings straight into roleALPHA

longDescription.default: A side panel for Microsoft Teams meetings: link the meeting to a circle, record what was agreed on each agenda item, and let rALPH, roleALPHA's assistant, turn it into proposals for roles, policies and accountabilities. People review every proposal; adopted ones become drafts in one roleALPHA scenario per meeting, which is submitted for decision by the participants. The result is posted to the meeting chat. The app runs in the browser and has no server of its own. Meeting outcomes are stored in roleALPHA, the only service outside your tenant the app talks to; nothing is stored in SharePoint. rALPH runs in roleALPHA, and no other AI service is used. Using the app needs a roleALPHA account. Reading the meeting chat and posting to it needs administrator consent for Microsoft Graph. The package contains the roleALPHA Sessions web part and a Microsoft Teams app (meeting tab and side panel, personal app).
